description: ocsp.rs line 109: .ok_or(Error::OcspStatusUnknown). If tbs_response_data.responses is empty (no SingleResponse entries), find() returns None and the error is OcspStatusUnknown. This is the correct hard-fail behavior per RFC 6960: if we cannot find a SingleResponse for the cert in question, we cannot assert revocation status, so hard-fail is appropriate. The behavior is correct; document it explicitly in rustdoc so callers understand this is intentional.
title: OcspChecker returns OcspStatusUnknown when responses list is empty
